description: Scheduled departures of a Shuttle-UM route on a date, optionally at one stop, from the published GTFS feed. Times are scheduled, not live; real-time arrivals are only in the Transit app. Without a stop only timepoint stops are listed, to keep the answer short. No login needed.

after.description: Only departures at or after this local time, as HH:MM

date.description: Service date as YYYY-MM-DD (default: today in College Park)

route.description: Route id as in transportation_list_routes, e.g. "104" (event routes have longer ids)

stop.description: Only departures from this stop, e.g. "1001"

name: transportation_get_schedule

departures.description: Departures in time order; stops without a scheduled time are estimates

direction.description: Direction of travel; null when the feed does not say

headsign.description: Destination shown on the bus from this stop

time.description: Local time as HH:MM:SS; hours run past 24 for trips after midnight, e.g. "25:10:00"

timepoint.description: true when the time is a scheduled timepoint, not an estimate

service_ids.description: GTFS service patterns active that day, e.g. "FA26RS Weekday"; empty means no service

title: Get Shuttle-UM departures
